name: Traction wheels in the middle
description: The S-curve on the 6-motor drive with drive encoders alone and traction wheels in the middle pair, then a turn to 180°. The path ends 0.86 in from its end point with odometry 1.1 in off. Switch Traction wheels to None and run again: on omnis the robot slides in the curves and ends 5.75 in off, with odometry 5.2 in off. The turn takes 0.95 s with traction wheels and 0.92 s on omnis.
